//: Type-checks the shipped `cirrus add` registry items (registry/<item>/*.ts) against the workspace packages they import. Not a build — `noEmit`. Run via the root `lint:types:registry` script, which the full `lint:types` chains after `vis run lint:types` has built every package's dist. `@cirrus/*` maps to each package's built declarations (not src) so the items are checked exactly as a consumer sees them, without recompiling package internals (which would pull Cloudflare-Workers globals from DO-backed packages). `bundler` resolution lets an item's `./schema.js` specifier resolve to its sibling `.ts`.
